_README: PLACEHOLDER thresholds so the scanner runs end to end. Replace with Josh's real rules. Each rule fires at a grid point/day when ALL conditions hold. A cluster of neighbouring firing points becomes an event once some rule has at least its min_points inside it. 'level' (1-3) is only used to detect escalation, it is NOT an impact rating. Fields come from docs/archive/raw/outlook.json (per point, per day): cape, shear (kt), scp, stp, ship, dcape, cin, rain (mm per UTC day), pop, tprob, hail/wind/flood/fire (tiers), cat (0 none, 1 TSTM, 2 MRGL, 3 MDT, 4 HIGH). 'days' is [first, last] lead day, 1-based, 1 = today.

rules.label: Model severe-storm category Moderate or higher
